mapper.insert: insert into dish (name, category_id, price, image, description, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user, status, is_groupon, groupon_price, groupon_size, groupon_valid_hours, stock, unit, origin, is_fresh) values (#{name}, #{categoryId}, #{price}, #{image}, #{description}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser}, #{status}, #{isGroupon}, #{grouponPrice}, #{grouponSize}, #{grouponValidHours}, #{stock}, #{unit}, #{origin}, #{isFresh})
mapper.select: select * from dish where is_groupon = 1 and status = 1 order by create_time desc
mapper.update: update dish set stock = stock - #{number}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and stock is not null and stock >= #{number} and status = 1
update dish set stock = stock + #{number}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and stock is not null
